newsitem.title: USA: Lift to US economy from tax cut questionable - Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Lift to US economy from tax cut questionable - Rubin.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Tuesday questioned the extent to which a cut in capital gains taxes would provide a lift to the economy.

"I think there is a very real question as to how much impact a generalized capital gains tax cut would have on general growth," Rubin said in testimony to the tax-writing House Ways and Means Committee.
He cited the questionable impact on growth as one reason the Clinton administration did not include a broad capital gains tax cut in its budget proposal.
